senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to enter into, take the place of,] to conquer; to take possession, to succeed, inherit.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:7">Gen. R. s. 11</cite>, end <he>י׳ את העולם במדה</he> had his worldly share assigned to him with limitation.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:9">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>ליוֹרְשֵׁנִי</he> to be my heir.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:5">B. Bath. VIII, 5</cite> <he>איש … לא יִירַשׁ וכ׳</he> this man, my son, shall not be an heir with the rest of his brothers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:5">Ib.</cite> <he>בתי תִירָֹשֵנִי</he> my daughter shall be my heiress.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ראוי ליוֹרְשׁוֹ</he> entitled to succeed him. Ib. IX, 1 (139ᵇ) <he>הבנים יִירְשׁוּ</he> (Bab. ed. <he>יֵרְשׁוּ</he>) the sons take possession of the estate; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="J00248"><he>יוֹרֵשׁ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to cause to inherit, to leave by will or by the law of succession; to transmit. Ib. 119ᵇ מוֹרִישִׁין ואינן יורשין they shall leave (the Holy Land to their children) but shall not take possession themselves.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 47a:7">Shebu. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>אין אדם מוֹרִישׁ שבועה לבניו</he> a man cannot transmit an oath to his sons, i.e. property to be obtained only by the claimant’s oath cannot be claimed by his heirs.
<cite ref="Ketubot 43a">Keth. 43ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 16b:14">Kidd. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אדם מוריש זכות בתו וכ׳</he> a man cannot bequeathe his daughter’s privileges to his sons.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:8">B. Bath. IX, 8</cite> if the house fell <he>עליו ועל מוֹרִישָׁיו</he> over himself (the heir) and his ancestors; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 51:2">Sifré Deut. 51</cite> <he>סמוך … לא הוֹרַשְׁתָּ</he> (the Jebusite) who is near thy palace thou hast not driven out; a. e.
